description: DocAgent style documentation sync: the README of a small library documents an older API (renamed methods, a method that became a property, a function that changed its return type, a changed default and a merge that is no longer in place), so several examples crash and others print stale output. A protected checks script extracts every python block from README.md, executes it and compares stdout with the text block that follows; the library code must stay unchanged, examples cannot be deleted, and old API names must disappear from the prose too.
